patch_description: Test a recovery-credit multiplier of four between the measured two and eight. Increasing the multiplier to eight slightly improved overall error, but worsened several cases, including case_009 and all four larger-radius, longer-interval cases. Executed allocations remained predominantly three particles, and substantial interval-end errors persisted. This proposal tests an intermediate threshold while preserving count three in the smaller-radius regime. Improvement remains unverified until evaluation.
